items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: I was playing with Jay I guess back in the early '30s when Jay was playing -- we both were playing small nightclubs and we got together and we played at a place called Wolf's Tavern.

ctx.x: I was thinking about the next person Jay McShann, I want to talk about, W McSham for example.

Well Jis out of Muskogee, Oklahoma. He came here at a very young age. I was playing with Jay I guess back in the early '30s when Jay was playing -- we both were playing small nightclubs and we got together and we played at a place called Wolf's Tavern.
